PFM.Settings.Enabled.Name: Enable Hello Chat
PFM.Settings.Enabled.Hint: Respond to the /hello chat command and show a greeting when the world is ready.
PFM.Settings.Greeting.Name: Greeting
PFM.Settings.Greeting.Hint: Text used in the hello message.
PFM.Grip.Changed2: {actor} now wields the {item} in two hands.
PFM.Grip.Changed1: {actor} now wields the {item} in one hand.
PFM.Grip.Error.notVersatile: The {item} is not Versatile, so it has only one grip.
PFM.Grip.Error.notEquipped: Equip the {item} before changing its grip.
PFM.Grip.Error.handInUse: The {item} needs a free hand to wield in two hands. Unequip the other weapon or shield first.
PFM.Tosslight.OwnLight: {token} already gives off light, so Reveal's tosslight was not added. Clear the token's light to use it.
PFM.Settings.RevealLight.Name: Reveal makes light (Crucible)
PFM.Settings.RevealLight.Hint: When the GM confirms a Reveal card, the target's token (or the caster's, with no target) gets a tosslight: bright 20 ft, dim 40 ft. Each caster has one at a time. Dismiss it from the token HUD.
PFM.Settings.KeepCoreHotbar.Name: Keep Foundry's Hotbar with Crucible Tongs
PFM.Settings.KeepCoreHotbar.Hint: Crucible Tongs replaces Foundry's macro hotbar while it shows your character, and its Macro tab holds the same macros. Turn this on to see both bars. Has no effect without Crucible Tongs.
PFM.Keybindings.OpenParty.Name: Open Party Sheet
PFM.Keybindings.OpenParty.Hint: Open the party group sheet set in Crucible's Primary Adventuring Party setting.
PFM.Party.Missing: No party is set. A GM can choose one in the Crucible system settings, under Primary Adventuring Party.
PFM.Keybindings.OpenCharacter.Name: Open Character Sheet
PFM.Keybindings.OpenCharacter.Hint: In combat, open the actor whose turn it is if you own it. Otherwise open your selected token's actor, or pick from your characters.
PFM.Character.None: You have no character to open. Select a token you own, or ask a GM to assign you a character.
PFM.Character.PickHint: Choose a character. Select or target one of your tokens to put it first, or select a single token to skip this list.
PFM.Party.Denied: You do not have permission to view the party. A GM can give you Limited or higher access to the party actor.
PFM.Stats.Title: Fight Stats
PFM.Stats.Empty: No fights recorded yet. The GM client records stats from chat cards during play.
PFM.Stats.CompanionHint: A companion or summon fighting for the party: a party member or a Friendly token that is not a hero. Its kills count as party kills. It is left out of the Party total, the MVP and the awards.
PFM.Stats.NoAdversaries: No adversaries recorded in this fight.
PFM.Stats.KillLegend.earned: they did the most damage, or tied for it
PFM.Stats.KillLegend.stolen: someone else did more damage, but they landed the last blow
PFM.Stats.KillLegend.assist: assist. Each bar shows everyone's share of the damage to that target; hover a segment for the amount.
PFM.Stats.FeetEstimated: Estimated from token positions. Live recording captures exact distances.
PFM.Stats.NoHero: No hero has stats in this fight.
PFM.Stats.History.Title: Import chat history into the stats
PFM.Stats.History.Preview: Found {fights} fights and {sessions} out-of-combat days in the chat log that the stats don't have yet. {skipped} cards are already recorded and will be skipped. Import them?
PFM.Stats.History.Nothing: The stats are up to date with the chat log ({skipped} cards already recorded).
PFM.Stats.History.Done: Imported {fights} fights and {sessions} out-of-combat days from the chat log.
PFM.Stats.History.GmOnly: Only a GM can import chat history into the stats.
PFM.Stats.Hint.Turns: Rounds in which this combatant acted
PFM.Stats.Hint.HitRate: Hits and glances, as a share of attacks
PFM.Stats.Hint.Kills: Final blows. Stolen means another combatant did more of the damage
PFM.Stats.Hint.Assists: Damage on an enemy that someone else finished
PFM.Stats.Hint.Healing: Health and morale restored to others
PFM.Stats.Hint.Heroism: Gained / spent. The value in brackets was lost when combat ended
PFM.Stats.Hint.AvgPos: Average place in the initiative order (1 = first)
PFM.Stats.Hint.CheckRate: Share of skill checks with a DC that passed
PFM.Stats.Hint.CheckRange: Lowest and highest skill check total
PFM.Stats.Hint.ChkCrits: Skill check critical successes / critical failures
PFM.Stats.Hint.DmgPerHit: Average damage per damaging hit, with the lowest and highest in brackets
PFM.Settings.ChronicleName.Name: Fight Journal Name
PFM.Settings.ChronicleName.Hint: Name of the journal where a write-up of each fight is kept. Players can read it. Changing this renames the journal.
PFM.Keybindings.OpenChronicle.Name: Open Roll of Valour
PFM.Keybindings.OpenChronicle.Hint: Open the fight stats window on the Roll of Valour tab: the write-up of each fight.
PFM.Keybindings.OpenStats.Name: Open Fight Stats
PFM.Stats.NoChronicle: No fights have been written up yet. A page is added when a combat ends.
PFM.Stats.NoChronicleAccess: You cannot view the fight journal. A GM can give you Observer access.
PFM.Stats.Hint.Status: Now: active in the party, benched, dead or insane
PFM.Stats.Hint.Fights: Combats this hero took part in
PFM.Stats.Hint.Record: Fights won and lost. The bracketed number is fights undecided or withdrawn.
PFM.Dose.AddictedHint: Each level weakens the next Dose of It'll Be Alright... by more than the last: 1, 3, 6, 10, 15 Madness and so on. A Rest lowers it by 1, but only after a night without a dose.
